The '''First Alsakan Conflict''' was a military conflict between [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] that lasted from 17,018 BBY to 16,700 BBY.

==Prelude==
During the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] openly competed for worlds in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] for colonization and natural resources. This rivalry grew throughout the era and was fueled, as well, by the [[Politics/Legends|politicking]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and other officials.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==The conflict==
Around [[17,000 BBY]], Alsakan led the worlds of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] in an attempt to block the [[Grand Companies]]&mdash;the major trading companies along the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] stretch of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]]&mdash;by moving south and claiming resource-rich systems. Alsakan was backed by a number of noble families in the Core Worlds that had holdings in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], such as [[House Juoni]] of [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].<ref name="Praji">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref> The Grand Companies objected to this move, and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] freighters began clashing with [[Atgeir-class battlecruiser|Alsakani warships]].<ref name="EGW" />

The Republic backed the Duros merchants, sparking a war between the two factions when they [[Republic assault on Virujansi|attacked]] [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] in [[17,018 BBY]]. [[17,012 BBY|Six years later]], Alsakan forces [[Alsakani liberation of Virujansi|liberated]] the planet. [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] would remain neutral by protecting its interests in the Rim. Notable battles during the conflict included the [[Battle of Kes]] in [[16,921 BBY]], the [[First Siege of Porus Vida]] in [[16,820 BBY]], and the [[Siege of Belasco]], which began in [[16,800 BBY]].<ref name="EGW" />

The First Alsakan Conflict would be ended by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] in [[16,700 BBY]], which threatened to withhold access to the system of hyperspace beacons. Hostilities would resume 500 years later in [[16,200 BBY]].<ref name="EGW" />

==Legacy==
The conflict was the first of seventeen between the two worlds,<ref name="HSATCSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> mostly fought in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The final attempt by Alsakan occurred in [[3017 BBY]].<ref name="EA" /> With the exception of the [[Sixth Alsakan Conflict|sixth]] and [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict|seventh]], the fourteen conflicts that would follow keep to the same pattern: Alsakan would come into conflict with the Republic, while Corellia attempted to remain neutral.<ref name="EGW" />

House Juoni's Expansion Region territories were utterly destroyed by [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardments]] during the conflict and the House's heads were imprisoned in the [[Centax-1 Maximum Correctional]] prison. The few survivors of the Juonii rapidly lost all their power, leaving [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] to the control of the rival Houses [[House Praji/Legends|Praji]] and [[House Vahali/Legends|Vahali]].<ref name="Praji" />
